Each item below is checked on its own. Passing one never implies another is ready.
EQO needs your own model provider key. The key is stored in the Android Keystore and never written to logs.
Model id to probe with (as listed by your provider)
Checking the key with the provider\u2026
Connected. The key is stored in the Android Keystore.
EQO drives apps through Android\'s accessibility service. You turn it on in Android\'s own settings — EQO never turns it on for you and never claims a grant it did not make.
I turned it on — check again
The EQO accessibility service is on.
The EQO accessibility service is off. Open Settings > Accessibility > EQO and turn it on.
Android 13+ may block this grant for sideloaded apps. This is Android\'s protection, not an EQO error: Settings > Apps > EQO > three-dot menu > Allow restricted settings, then try the toggle again.

Android\'s wireless debugging uses two different ports. The pairing port is shown inside the "Pair device with pairing code" dialog, next to the pairing code. The connection port is the "IP address & port" value on the wireless debugging screen itself.
Did not run — an earlier step failed first.

The live connection step is switched off in this study build until the server-key pinning work lands (security follow-up SF-1). The steps below still explain exactly what to tap in Android\'s own settings, and every check reports its own state.

What EQO would send if browser control is used: the text of the current web page and the result of small scripts run on it, to the model provider you configured. Screen content is never sent anywhere else.
Redaction is best-effort. Sensitive content may still be visible to the model.
Declining turns off browser control only. Everything else keeps working.
No thanks — keep browser control off
Browser control is allowed. Browser functions are still off in this study build (see the note below).
Browser control is off. You can change this any time.

Browser functions are switched off in this study build until the debugging-endpoint ownership checks land (security follow-up SF-1). Your consent answer is kept either way, and no page content has been sent.
